compiled_state.title: As a project maintainer, CI llm-review applies the same size-based tier upgrade as local /dso:review, driven by configurable dso-config thresholds
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Close the size-based upgrade gap between local /dso:review and CI llm-review.

The local REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md Step 3b upgrades diffs ≥300 scorable lines from light/standard tier to opus (via dso:code-reviewer-deep-arch) before dispatching. ci-llm-review-runner.sh receives `size_action` in the classifier output but currently ignores it, so 300+ line diffs classified as standard or light get a lighter review in CI than they would locally.

Additionally, both the upgrade threshold (300) and the warn threshold (600) are hardcoded in review-complexity-classifier.sh. They should be config-driven so projects can tune them without patching the plugin.

**Scope**:
- IN: Two new config keys read by review-complexity-classifier.sh: `review.size_upgrade_lines` (default 300) and `review.size_warn_lines` (default 600). Both read via read-config.sh with fallback to defaults.
- IN: ci-llm-review-runner.sh reads `size_action` from classifier output; when `upgrade`, routes to the deep tier model regardless of selected_tier (same behaviour as local Step 3b REVIEW_AGENT_OVERRIDE).
- IN: No hard cap — diffs of any size proceed to review (the huge-diff file-count gate at review.huge_diff_file_threshold=20 is a separate routing gate and is unaffected).
- OUT: review.huge_diff_file_threshold (file-count gate) — separate concern, not changed.
- OUT: REVIEW-WORKFLOW-HUGE.md routing — unaffected.

## Done Definitions

- When complete, review-complexity-classifier.sh reads `review.size_upgrade_lines` from dso-config.conf via read-config.sh, falling back to 300 when absent; verified by a test that sets the key and confirms the threshold changes.
- When complete, review-complexity-classifier.sh reads `review.size_warn_lines` from dso-config.conf via read-config.sh, falling back to 600 when absent; verified by a test.
- When complete, ci-llm-review-runner.sh reads `size_action` from the classifier JSON output; when `size_action=upgrade`, the runner routes to the deep tier model (same effective tier upgrade as local Step 3b); verified by a test that injects a classifier response with size_action=upgrade and asserts the runner dispatches a deep-model call.
- When complete, a diff of any size is reviewed without error — there is no hard line-count cap that causes the runner to exit early or skip review; verified by a test with a large diff.
- When complete, `review.size_upgrade_lines` and `review.size_warn_lines` are documented in plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md with default values, valid ranges, and examples.
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic.
